chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who acknowledged a debt in favor of one of his heirs while he was ill. He said: "It is permissible if that which he acknowledged is less than one-third."

key_terms.الثُّلُثِ: one-third, the legal threshold mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.بِدَيْنٍ: with a debt; a financial liability being acknowledged
key_terms.مَرِيضٌ: a person in a state of illness, relevant here to end-of-life legal rulings
key_terms.وَارِثٍ: an heir entitled to inherit from the deceased
key_terms.يَجُوزُ: it is permissible or legally valid

ai.seo_question: Is a sick person's acknowledgment of debt in favor of an heir valid in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the acknowledgment of debt by a sick person in favor of an heir. The Imam عليه السلام states that such an acknowledgment is valid when the amount acknowledged is less than one-third, indicating a limit tied to estate disposition during illness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5540 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from Isma'il ibn Jabir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who, while ill and in debt, acknowledged a right for one of his heirs.
Imam (as) said: "It is permissible if what he acknowledged is less than one-third (of his wealth)."
